bayts.text: I have praised the Prophet, the Select One, the Light, for long ages, for the Face of a Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm) Who has never ceased to be All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān).
My Master protected me from Satan and harm, by the rank of an intercessor who led goodness to me from Him.
I am well pleased with the Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) and with the best of His creation, and in praising him I have surpassed Kaʿb (ibn Zuhayr) and Ḥassān (ibn Thābit).
I raised to the Chosen One, for Allah, for a span, my ink and my pens, and he adorned my scale.
Allah erased, by his rank, illnesses heading toward me, just as Allah repelled sorrows toward other than my heart.
Muḥammad, the Chosen One, is the Effacer and the Honourer: upon him the blessing of Allah, as long as He remains the Helper.
The love of his person has called me to praise the Prophet: upon him the peace of Allah, as long as I win good pleasure.
My God protected me, through the Prophet, from harm, and the Chosen One, by Allah, made the lands good for me.
When I lead a service to the Chosen One, for Allah, the Everlasting through it spares me wretchedness and Satan.
I have praised, for the Chosen One, my Lord Who erased faults heading toward my person, and led forgiveness to me.
Allah erased the intent of harm toward me, by the rank of him to whom, through Him, I conveyed what surpassed the neighbours.
The love of his person has called me to the Prophet's service, with my love for a Most Merciful Who has never ceased to be All-Merciful.
